reviewed_by: Claude review of the always-send MCP servers change
reason: A provider chat's ticked MCP servers are now always sent (their tools are pinned out of the on-demand catalog), and every other enabled, probed server with a usable tool joins the catalog that Jev or the local ranker picks from. chat.py builds the catalog only for a turn that already uses tools and only when the project defers tools, records it as mcp_catalog_snapshot so prepare_resume rebuilds the same catalog, and asks Jev only about catalog servers. mcp.py gains usable_mcp_tools (the one tool filter now shared by resolve_mcp_profiles, build_mcp_tool_plugins and the tool-candidates endpoint) and catalog_mcp_profiles; tool_catalog.deferrable_specs gains always_loaded_sources. The Python selection is test_tool_catalog.py and test_tool_suggestions.py, whose prepare tests now run on real stored server profiles (a ticked notes server and an on-demand tracker server) and cover the always-sent split, on-demand off, a plain chat, resume from the snapshot and the catalog lookup; test_mcp_probe.py for the shared tool filter; and test_chat.py for the prepare path the catalog joins. The frontend selection is the new McpServerChoices component test (row states, hint, Jev implying deferral, scope failure, empty state), client.test.ts for mapping on_demand_tools without writing it back, and guides.test.tsx for the edited MCP guide step. Playwright selects the assistant-settings-navigation area, which opens the provider Assistant settings popover on desktop and both phones, and the assistant-viewer desktop entry, whose browser Assistant test asserts the popover's empty MCP state stays in view.
exclusions: Full Python, frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. No native tests: no Rust changed. The broad assistant, provider-reasoning, provider-thinking and chat-edit-in-place areas that chat.py and SessionsPage.tsx map to are not selected: the SessionsPage change swaps one inline checklist for McpServerChoices with the same props, and the chat.py change is confined to which MCP profiles feed the tool components, which the selected Python tests exercise directly. The mcp-import area is not selected: mcp.py changes only the tool filter shared by runtime and candidates, not import. ui/src/App.test.tsx is not selected; its 'keeps diagnostics out of the advanced view while preserving legacy hashes' test fails only when the whole file runs and is already red on main. Missions, schedules, subagents and harness chats read only mcp_server_ids, which keeps its meaning, so their suites are not selected.
